faq.q: Can Amazon product photos include lifestyle and detail views in one listing?
faq.a: Yes. Start with one clear product photo, then make a white-background main image, detail views, and lifestyle scenes for the listing gallery. Check Amazon's current category rules before publishing.

faq.q: What are Amazon's main image requirements?
faq.a: The main image needs a pure white background and a product that fills about 85% of the square frame, with no text, badges or props. Check Seller Central for the current rules.

faq.q: Can I make a white-background main from a regular photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo and pick the white main. The product is rebuilt on a plain white background, so you do not book a studio.

faq.q: What happens if an image does not meet Amazon's rules?
faq.a: Amazon may suppress a non-compliant image, and the listing can stop showing in search. Use a correct white main and keep extra callouts on the other gallery images.

faq.q: Which images should follow the main image?
faq.a: Add a lifestyle shot, a close detail, and a size cue, in that order. Each image should answer the shopper's next question about the product.

faq.q: Can I add text callouts to my images?
faq.a: Add them yourself in Canva or a similar tool after download. Keep the main image plain, and put callouts only on secondary images.
Use a sharp, well-lit photo that shows the whole product. A clear front view works well for a main image rebuild.

faq.q: Can I make a video for my Amazon listing?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC makes short clips of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Check Amazon's current Sponsored Brands and product video rules before you use one.

faq.q: Are the images mine to use in my listing?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours to use, but you are responsible for matching Amazon's current rules.
